items.title: Exxon Eyes Shell’s $8 Billion U.S. Chemicals Business
items.summary: ExxonMobil is among several bidders pursuing all or part of Shell’s U.S. chemicals business in a potential deal valued at up to $8 billion.

items.title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Joins Early Section 48E Tax Equity Deal
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) is involved in one of the industry's first Section 48E tax equity transactions to fund distributed clean energy projects in Illinois, alongside Summit Ridge Energy and Foss & Company. The deal supports community solar projects in Illinois and applies the new Section 48E clean electricity investment tax credit framework. The transaction highlights Apollo's focus on energy transition opportunities and potential platform growth in sustainable infrastructure...
